grammar.pattern: 完成动作 + 了 + 就 + 后续动作
grammar.explanation: 看了通知就问她 says the asking follows reading the notice. The second event is not necessarily guaranteed whenever the first occurs; read the stated context and tense. 买了就用 is distinct from 一买就用 habitual or immediate framing.

examples.py: wǒ kàn le tōng zhī jiù wèn tā .
examples.en: After reading the notice I asked her.

examples.py: dào le shì chǎng jiù hé duì jià gé .
examples.en: After reaching the market, check prices.

examples.py: tā wèn le tiáo jiàn jiù jì xià lái .
examples.en: After asking the conditions, she notes them.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看了通知就问她，说明没看通知。
commonMistakes.right: 这句话先说看通知，再说问她。
commonMistakes.why: The first event precedes the second in this report.

grammar.pattern: 数量 + 左右 / 大约 + 数量；相邻数
grammar.explanation: 十个人左右 and 大约十个人 are approximate, not exactly ten. 三四个人 is normally three or four people; do not generalize adjacent numerals to a mathematically exact range in every context. Avoid redundant 大约…左右 in careful precision tasks.

examples.py: shí gè rén zuǒ yòu cān jiā .
sān sì gè rén hái méi dào .
examples.en: Three or four people have not arrived.

commonMistakes.wrong: 十个人左右就是正好十个。
commonMistakes.right: 十个人左右是大概，不是精确数。
commonMistakes.why: Approximation does not establish exact equality.

dialogue.title: What actually increased?
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the quantity and its scope.

lines.zh: 通知说人数增加五个，是百分之五吗？
lines.py: tōng zhī shuō rén shù zēng jiā wǔ gè , shì bǎi fēn zhī wǔ ma ?
lines.en: The notice says five more people. Is that five percent?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，增加人数和比例不同，要看原来多少。
lines.py: bù shì , zēng jiā rén shù hé bǐ lì bù tóng , yào kàn yuán lái duō shao .
lines.en: No; a count increase differs from a proportion; check the original total.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 某个商品价格上升，整个市场都涨了吗？
lines.py: mǒu gè shāng pǐn jià gé shàng shēng , zhěng gè shì chǎng dōu zhǎng le ma ?
lines.en: A certain product’s price rose. Did the entire market rise?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没说。经济报道也要看时间和范围。
lines.py: méi shuō . jīng jì bào dào yě yào kàn shí jiān hé fàn wéi .
lines.en: It does not say; economic reports need time and scope.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 大约三十块，十个人左右，都是准确数吗？
lines.py: dà yuē sān shí kuài , shí gè rén zuǒ yòu , dōu shì zhǔn què shù ma ?
lines.en: About thirty yuan and about ten people: are they exact?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是。我看了通知就问她，先核对再记录。
lines.py: bù shì . wǒ kàn le tōng zhī jiù wèn tā , xiān hé duì zài jì lù .
lines.en: No. After reading the notice I asked her; verify before recording.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Costs without invented precision
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 商品值多少还没确认，商业介绍与实际付款记录分开。费时间也不是金额。
lines.py: shāng pǐn zhí duō shao hái méi què rèn , shāng yè jiè shào yǔ shí jì fù kuǎn jì lù fēn kāi . fèi shí jiān yě bù shì jīn é .
lines.en: A product’s value is unconfirmed; keep commercial descriptions separate from payments; time spent is not money.

lines.zh: 总量增长不说明每个人都增加，价格升了也先问比较时间。
lines.py: zǒng liàng zēng zhǎng bù shuō míng měi gè rén dōu zēng jiā , jià gé shēng le yě xiān wèn bǐ jiào shí jiān .
lines.en: Total growth does not mean every individual increased; ask the comparison period for price rises.

lines.zh: 突出数字可能只是一部分，特色和发达不表示所有人都满意。
lines.py: tū chū shù zì kě néng zhǐ shì yī bù fèn , tè sè hé fā dá bù biǎo shì suǒ yǒu rén dōu mǎn yì .
lines.en: A prominent number may be only one part; distinctiveness and development do not imply universal satisfaction.

lines.zh: 报道说石油价格，这里没有投资建议。环保要看具体做法，环境要现场观察。
lines.py: bào dào shuō shí yóu jià gé , zhè lǐ méi yǒu tóu zī jiàn yì . huán bǎo yào kàn jù tǐ zuò fǎ , huán jìng yào xiàn chǎng guān chá .
lines.en: The report discusses oil prices without investment advice; check environmental actions and observe conditions.

lines.zh: 环形图里有大象和石头，旁边卖啤酒，但图片不代表实际数量或年龄许可。
lines.py: huán xíng tú lǐ yǒu dà xiàng hé shí tou , páng biān mài pí jiǔ , dàn tú piàn bù dài biǎo shí jì shù liàng huò nián líng xǔ kě .
lines.en: The loop diagram depicts an elephant and stones, with beer sold nearby; the picture does not establish quantities or age permission.

lines.zh: 她作为负责人说，任你怎么说，普及活动也先核对。值得问，不等于必须买。
lines.py: tā zuò wéi fù zé rén shuō , rèn nǐ zěn me shuō , pǔ jí huó dòng yě xiān hé duì . zhí de wèn , bù děng yú bì xū mǎi .
lines.en: As leader she says: whatever you say, verify the outreach activity first; worth asking does not mean compulsory purchase.

lines.py: shāng pǐn zhí duō shao hái méi què rèn , shāng yè jiè shào yǔ shí jì fù kuǎn jì lù fēn kāi . fèi shí jiān yě bù shì jīn é .
lines.en: A product’s value is unconfirmed; keep commercial descriptions separate from payments; time spent is not money.

lines.py: dà yuē yǐ jīng gào sù nǐ , bù shì jīng què shù .

lines.py: hǎo , wǒ jīng què de zhī dào zì jǐ hái bù zhī dào .
lines.en: Fine; I precisely know I do not yet know.
